FPDF 1.9 by Olivier Plathey (http://www.fpdf.org) - permissive licence, see license.txt.
font/dejavu.* and font/dejavub.*: DejaVu Sans / Bold (Bitstream Vera licence, free to embed and redistribute), subset to Latin-1 + punctuation + the rupee sign,
generated with FPDF's makefont using a custom code page in which byte 0x80 is the rupee sign (U+20B9) instead of the euro sign. app/pdf.php converts UTF-8 to that code page.
